properties.name: Toms River NH/9 Eiruv
properties.hotline: 732-426-3370 (weekly eruv update, text) · eruv supervision (Mishmeres Eruvin Lemehadrin) 845-709-7324
properties.contacts: Mishmeres Eruvin Lemehadrin (Eruvin USA): 845-709-7324, Eruvinusa@gmail.com. Weekly eruv update by text: 732-426-3370 (per the official map).
properties.source_name: Official map “Toms River New Jersey – eruv boundaries” (Mishmeres Eruvin Lemehadrin / Vaad Mishmeres HaEruvin)
properties.source_date: Hechsher printed as valid until Tishrei 5788 (fall 2027); received Oct 18, 2026
properties.notes: Traced from the official map onto OpenStreetMap streets (the map was lined up to the street network, about 7 m per map pixel; the boundary follows the map's red line, accuracy roughly ±10–15 m). Boundaries: Rt 70 on the north, Lakewood Rd (US-9) on the west, W Whitty Rd on the south and the Garden State Parkway on the east, with the jogs around Leisure Village and along New Hampshire Ave / Silverton Rd as drawn. Per the map: the whole colored area is in the eruv; where the boundary runs along a street, that street is marked red and is NOT in the eruv (Rt 70 and US-9 themselves are outside). New Hampshire Ave is in the eruv, except from just north of Bridgeport Dr to just before Hickory St, where you may carry only on the sidewalk on the even-numbered side, not on the street or the other sidewalk. Check the weekly eruv update before Shabbos.
properties.auspices: Under the hashgacha of Vaad Mishmeres HaEruvin – HaRav Yechiel Steinmetz shlit"a (Monsey). The Toms River eruv organization stands under the city's Vaad Rabbonim: HaRav Pinchos Vind, HaRav Moshe Rotberg, HaRav Zalman Gifter, HaRav Mordechai Dov Sekula and HaRav Meir Boruch Turin (names as printed in Hebrew on the map).

The 401 can ONLY be crossed at Bathurst, Wilson and Bayview, NOT at Keele, Dufferin, Avenue or Yonge; the 401 and its access points are excluded. Bentworth and Dupont are NOT in the eruv. Along Griffin Road, the Eruv extends north to the canal from the Hilton Hotel west to Alistar Road/40th Avenue. properties.name: Highland Park, IL Eruv
properties.contacts: The Highland Park, IL Eruv — (847) 266-0770, hp-eruv.com. Approved by Rabbi Benzion Twerski and Rabbi Shmuel Fuerst (Dayan of Agudath Israel).
properties.source_name: Highland Park, IL eruv map (eruv.org listing)
properties.notes: Traced from the eruv's published map (Highland Park, IL eruv map (eruv.org listing), posted June 2026): the blue line (and the black bluff line on the lake front) on the Google-map screenshot, georeferenced at Clavey Rd × Green Bay Rd, Lake Cook Rd × Sheridan Rd, Roger Williams Ave × Sheridan Rd, and the bike path × Park Ave and × Clavey Rd (affine). Runs along Park Ave W/Vine Ave/Egandale Rd (north), the lake-front bluff (north-east), Roger Williams Ave and Sheridan Rd (east), Lake Cook Rd (south), Green Bay Rd and Clavey Rd, and the bike path east of the railroad tracks (west; US-41 is inside). Uncertain: accuracy ~20–30 m (control-point residuals 15.5, 25.3, 21.1, 9.9, 12.0 m); the short jogs by the hospital on Park Ave and by Roger Williams/Sheridan follow the drawing. Map details: Map labels: “Bike Path East of R.R. Tracks” (west edge) and “Bluff on Lake Front” (north-east edge). Printed on the map: The Highland Park, IL Eruv — tel (847) 266-0770, www.hp-eruv.com; approved by Rabbi Benzion Twerski and Rabbi Shmuel Fuerst, Dayan of Agudath Israel. Traced from the eruv's published map (posted June 2026); unofficial — check the local hotline before Shabbos.
properties.auspices: Certified by Rabbi Yosef Schanowitz · Posek: Rabbi S. Fuerst, Rabbi B. Twerski

Main Eruv (blue, א): uses tel hamislaket (steep slopes — 12 slope/wall segments marked on the map), utility poles with city wires and its own lechis where needed; most lechis are gud asik; the eruv is checked weekly. properties.name: Far North Dallas
properties.contacts: Congregation Toras Chaim (Rabbi Yaakov Rich), listed as the eruv website — (972) 835-6016
properties.source_name: Dallas Area Eruvs – Google My Map (linked by Congregation Toras Chaim and DallasTorah.org)
properties.notes: Traced from the eruv's published map (Dallas Area Eruvs – Google My Map (linked by Congregation Toras Chaim and DallasTorah.org), fetched Oct 14 2026): boundary lines copied from the community's Dallas Area Eruvs Google map and joined into one closed area (no gaps). Boundary rules published by Congregation Toras Chaim: FAR NORTH DALLAS ERUV BOUNDARIES ON THE NORTH Both sides of Frankford between Winding Creek and the west side of Aramis are IN, but stay south of the utility poles on the north side of Frankford. (The boundary crosses over Frankford just east of the water tower to the NW corner of Aramis and Frankford). From this point to Coit BOTH sides of Frankford are OUT. Streets south of Frankford between Winding Creek and Coit are IN. Highland Creek Manor is IN the Eruv. It joins the Eruv near the poles that are westernmost (near Torah Day school) and easternmost (towards Coit) that are in front of the brick wall of the Highland Creek Manor. To be sure, stay on the sidewalk and enter via the front gate. The boundary follows the walls and fences of Highland Creek Manor. If you leave via the rear gate, you will leave the Eruv. ON THE EAST You cannot walk anywhere on Coit Road. All roads just west of Coit are in the Eruv, EXCEPT the east most section of McCallum in front of the Chatham Court and Gables apartment complexes. The Gables is OUT of the Eruv. Chatham Court itself is IN the Eruv but to stay in the Eruv and to get onto McCallum, you must keep north of the telephone poles until you reach the car wash place. The boundary crosses McCallum to go south between the Gables and McCallum Meadows apartments. All the other apartments on both sides of the road are in the Eruv. The Eruv from McCallum to Campbell follows the fence and wall behind the Target shopping center on the NW quadrant of Campbell and Coit. Lauder Lane and Cleary Circle are IN, but Cafe Fino is NOT. Lauder Lane south of Campbell is IN, but do not go onto Coit. Between Lauder and Arapaho, all roads between Coit and Meandering (EXCLUDING COIT and INCLUDING MEANDERING) are in the Eruv. Also EXCLUDED is the Spanish Village (Borders) shopping center on the NW corner of Arapaho and Coit. ON THE SOUTH For all practical purposes both sides of Arapaho itself are OUT of the Eruv. Along one small section between the east side of Spring Valley and the alleyway next to the Don Pepe Rancho restaurant on the south side, you are IN the Eruv. ON THE WEST Between Meandering and Arbor Oaks, the Eruv is on the West side of Meandering. Both sides of Meandering Way are IN the Eruv. BETWEEN MEANDERING AND HILLCREST The boundary is the telephone line on the NORTH side of the right-of-way area that contains the power lines. You can walk in the alley on the NORTH SIDE. CAMPBELL GREEN is NOT in the Eruv. HILLCREST TO MCCALLUM From the south end of Campbell Green, the boundary is the west side of Hillcrest. Both sides of Hillcrest in this section are IN, but you must stay to the east of the telephone poles. The alley west of the telephone poles on the west side of Hillcrest is OUT. MCCALLUM TO DAVENPORT ONLY enter Ohev Shalom from HILLCREST. Both sides of McCallum west of the pole at the corner of McCallum and Hillcrest until Duffield are OUT. The houses on the north side of McCallum are actually IN, and so are their front yards up until the poles. At the NE corner of McCallum and Duffield the boundary crosses McCallum diagonally to the SW corner and picks up the poles in the alleyway backing onto McCallum. The boundary crosses back diagonally from the SE corner of McCallum and Davenport to the NW corner of Davenport and McCallum. Between these two points both sides of McCallum are IN. McCallum Highland apartments are IN. But to get from this point to Ohev Shalom, you must walk via Shellflower and Hillcrest. DAVENPORT TO WINDING CREEK Between McCallum and Winding Creek both sides of DAVENPORT are IN. Keep south of the wire which crosses Davenport on the north side of Winding Creek. WINDING CREEK TO FRANKFORD With the exception below, both sides (sidewalks) of WINDING CREEK are in the ERUV (BUT THE HOUSES ON THE NORTH SIDE ARE NOT). EXCEPTION: YOU MUST STAY ON THE SOUTH OR EAST SIDES OF THE TELEPHONE POLES AT ALL TIMES. PLEASE NOTE THAT THERE IS A POLE ON THE SOUTH SIDE IN THE PARK ON WINDING CREEK. So if you are on the North side of Winding Creek one must cross the road and go onto the park and around this pole to get back on to Frankford. Note: a realtor's copy of the map (Robkin Real Estate) draws a larger Far North Dallas area reaching west to Preston Rd (about 1,525 ha vs 598 ha here); that may be a newer expansion — confirm with the eruv before relying on the western part. Uncertain: which version of the western boundary is current (Meandering/Hillcrest here vs Preston Rd on the realtor map). Traced from the eruv's published map (fetched Oct 14 2026); unofficial — check the local hotline before Shabbos.

Crossings between the two eruvin: Crossing A: The crossing tunnel under the rail line at the Merion Station; Crossing B: The Bowman Avenue Bridge; Crossing C: The Narberth Bridge (South Narberth Avenue); Crossing D: The crossing tunnel under the Narberth Station; Crossing E: Under the North Wynnewood Bridge. This is the arched stone bridge going under the train tracks near the Narberth playground.; Lankenau Hospital Route: Although most of the sidewalks on City Ave are beyond both eruvin, the sidewalk between Wynnewood Road and Lancaster Avenue on the Main Line side is now inside the Main Line eruv to allow people to walk from Lower Merion to Lankenau Hospital. Hill Gate: Entrance to Hill Gate is within the eruv only via Righters Ferry Rd. See Instructions (http://lowermerioneruv.org/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2011/01/west-laurel-hill-entrance-eruv.png) (addition June 2013). Railway Border: The Eruv on the west border of Center City is hard to see; it uses existing structures from the railway system. River Border: The river walk which begins at Locust Point apartment complex and follows the Schuylkill River north is beyond of the Eruv's boundaries. Poplar Street: Carrying is permitted on the south side of Poplar Street. South Street Bridge: You may carry across the South Street Bridge, which connects to the University City Eruv. South Philadelphia section notes: East side of Front: East side of Front; West side of I-95: West side of I-95; I-76 overpass: I-76 overpass; Lavud: Lavud from fence to light pole; Wires: String crosses Darien Street; I-76 barrier wall: I-76 barrier wall; I-76/Moyamensing overpass: I-76/Moyamensing overpass; Line 28: Wall under rail overpass; Line 12: Short string from fence to utility pole; Powerline: Power line (taḥuv into east side of west pole, 2nd from bottom); Fencing: Fence along PGW plant. properties.notes: Traced from the eruv's published map (North Seattle Eruv – Google My Map, fetched Oct 14 2026): 25 boundary lines joined into one closed area (no gaps). Street-by-street notes from the map: 25th Ave NE: Boundary East side of 25th. Inside the eruv Best to walk on streets east of 25th. Most of the east sidewalk of 25th is inside except at NE 60th. Stay on the east side of all phone/utility poles. beyond the eruv 25th itself and the west sidewalk of 25th. | NE 65th St: Boundary North side of 65th. Inside the eruv Best to walk on streets north of 65th. Most, but not all, of the north sidewalk of 65th is inside. Stay on the north side of all utility/phone poles on 65th. beyond the eruv 65th itself and the south sidewalk are beyond as are streets south of 65th. | 15th Ave NE: Boundary West side of 15th. Inside the eruv 15th itself and the east sidewalk. West sidewalk of 15th is variable in/out. beyond the eruv Some portions of the west sidewalk of 15th are beyond as are streets to the west of 15th. | Lake City Way NE: Boundary West/north side of Lake City Way. Inside the eruv Lake City Way itself and the south/east sidewalk. beyond the eruv North and west of Lake City Way. | NE 85th St: Boundary South side of 85th. Switches to north side of 85th just before crossing over Ravenna Ave to 25th. Inside the eruv South of 85th. Best to walk on streets south of 85th. beyond the eruv Both sides of 85th and northward. | 25th Ave NE: Boundary West and East sides of 25th. Inside the eruv 25th itself and east shoulder. No sidewalks here. beyond the eruv West shoulder of 25th, including Ravenna Ave north of 85th | NE 94th St: Boundary North side of 94th. Inside the eruv 94th itself and south shoulder. No sidewalks here. beyond the eruv North of 94th. | 27th Ave NE: Boundary East side of 27th. Inside the eruv Streets east of 27th. Best to use 30th. beyond the eruv 27th itself and both shoulders. No sidewalks here. | NE 95th St: Boundary West of 35th, the boundary is on south side of 95th. East of 35th, the boundary is on the north side of 95th. This area was updated in December 2016 and again in 2026. Inside the eruv To the west of 35th, streets south of 95th are inside the eruv. Few sidewalks present on 95th, so best to walk on streets south of 95th. To the east of 35th, 95th itself and the south shoulder are inside the eruv. beyond the eruv North of 95th is beyond. | NE 95th St @ Thornton Creek: Boundary North side of 95th until it crosses into the Thornton Creek Natural Area about 1 block west of Sand Point Way. Inside the eruv 95th itself and the south shoulder are inside the eruv. beyond the eruv North of 95th and the whole corner/intersection of 95th and Sand Point Way is beyond. | Thornton Creek Natural Area, corner of Sand Point and 95th: Boundary Enters ravine at northwest corner of Thornton Ck Natural Area and uses the western slope as the boundary over to the Burke-Gilman trail. Crosses the B-G trail and connects to the west side of Sand Point Way. Inside the eruv Best to avoid this area. Although this is a city park, only the upper west ridge of the ravine is inside and no trails exist there. beyond the eruv All but the western ridge of the ravine are out. The ravine itself is out. Intersection of 95th and Sand Point Way is out. | Sand Point Way NE, north: Boundary West side of Sand Point Way. Inside the eruv Best to walk on the Burke-Gilman trail all along Sand Point Way NE. In this northern portion of Sand Point Way, the west sidewalk is inside between 65th and 70th. North of 70th, use B-G trail. beyond the eruv Sand Point Way itself and both shoulders are beyond. Use Burke-Gilman trail. | Sand Point Way NE, south: Boundary Along the south/east side of Sand Point Way. Inside the Eruv Best to walk on the Burke-Gilman trail all along Sand Point Way NE. In this southern portion of Sand Point Way, the street itself and the north/west shoulder are inside. But few sidewalks exist on the north/west side of Sand Point Way. beyond the Eruv The south/east sidewalk of Sandpoint Way and streets south and east of Sand Point Way. | Windermere North Apartments: Boundary Along the west side of 60th and the south side of 63rd. Inside the Eruv This area was strung to include the Windermere North apartments on the east side of Sand Point Way. To stay inside the eruv from Windermere North apartments, use the cross-walk at the SW corner of the buliding and cross to the west side of Sand Point Way. Then walk through the parking lot of the Sandpointer condominiums to 65th St. beyond the Eruv 60th itself and the east sidewalk of 60th are beyond as is the south sidewalk of 63rd. | 47th Ave NE: Boundary Switches from east to west side of 47th. Inside the Eruv The west sidewalk of 47th. beyond the Eruv The east sidewalk of 47th. | NE 47th St: Boundary North side of 47th. Inside the Eruv The north sidewalk of 47th. beyond the Eruv 47th itself and the south sidewalk of 47th. | 46th Ave NE: Boundary The west side of 46th. Inside the Eruv The west sidewalk of 46th. beyond the Eruv 46th itself and the east sidewalk of 46th. | NE 45th St: Boundary South side of 45th. Inside the Eruv 45th itself and the north sidewalk of 45th. beyond the Eruv South sidewalk of 45th. | 37th Ave NE: Boundary East side of 37th. Inside the Eruv 37th itself and the west sidewalk. beyond the Eruv The east sidewalk of 37th. | NE 41st St: Boundary South side of 41st Inside the Eruv 41st itself and the north sidewalk of 41st are inside beyond the Eruv The south sidewalk of 41st is beyond as is the Center for Urban Horticulture | Mary Gates Memorial Dr NE: Boundary West side of Mary Gates Memorial Dr., along fence adjacent to UW (IMA) sports fields and then along poles southward Inside the Eruv The street itself (MGM Dr.) and the east sidewalk. The west sidewalk is inside adjacent to the UW sports fields, but is beyond south of NE Clark Rd after the boundary switches from the fence to the poles (going southward). beyond the Eruv The UW sports fields are beyond along with the west sidewalk on MGM Dr. south of NE Clark Rd | Montlake Blvd and NE 45th St: Boundary The boundary alternates between poles and the fence on the south side of 45th as it curves south and becomes Montlake Blvd. Inside Both sides of 45th and all sidewalks in this area are inside. beyond Beyond (south side) of the sidewalk on the south side of 45th | NE 45th St: Boundary Along the fence of the UW (IMA) sports fields that runs along the south side of the sidewalk on 45th. Inside the eruv Both sides and all sidewalks of 45th are inside in this section beyond the eruv The UW sports fields are beyond, along with anything south of the fence | 25th Ave NE south of NE Blakeley St: Boundary On poles along the east side of 25th Ave NE Inside The east sidewalk of 25th is in, along with the Silver Cloud Inn, University Village area, and Safeway. Stay on the east side of all utility poles along the sidewalk on 25th. beyond The street itself (25th) is out along with any area west of the sidewalk on the east side of 25th. | NE 44th St: Boundary The boundary does not actually go along 44th. Rather, it is north of 44th on poles through the UW parking area E2 and then across Montlake Blvd to the pole-and-fence section that continues eastward along Montlake/45th. Inside Best to avoid this area as there is no walkable sidewalk inside the eruv along 44th. Walk through University Village in this area to stay inside the eruv. beyond NE 44th St and all sidewalks (both sides) on 44th are out. Street-side notes from the map, verbatim: Note 1 On 111th Street, between Manhattan Avenue and the FDR Drive, only the south side of the street is in the eruv. Please Note: The intersection of 111th Street and Park Avenue is not included in the eruv. Note 2 The intersection of 111th Street and Park Avenue is not included in the eruv. When walking (and carrying) east or west on 111th Street, turn south on Park Avenue and cross at 110th Street. Note 3 On Cathedral Parkway, between Columbus and Manhattan Avenues, only the south side of the street is in the eruv. On Manhattan Avenue, between Cathedral Parkway and 111th Street, only the east side of the street is in the eruv. Note 4 On Amsterdam Avenue, between 126th (St. Mary’s Place) and 123rd Streets, only the west side of the street is in the eruv. Note 5 On 126th Street (St. Mary’s Place), between Amsterdam and Broadway, only the south side of street is in the eruv. Note 6 Riverside Park, on the east side of the West Side Highway from 72nd Street to 95th Street, is included in the eruv. Portions of Riverside Park west of the West Side Highway or north of 95th Street are not included. Note 7 On Tenth Avenue, between 56th and 58th Streets, only the east side of the street is in the eruv. Note 8 On West End Avenue, between 58th and 60th Streets, only the east side of the street is in the eruv. Note 9 On 58th Street, between Tenth and Eleventh (West End) Avenues, only the north side of the street is in the eruv. Note 10 On 56th Street, between Broadway and Tenth Avenue (Amsterdam), only the north side of the street is in the eruv. Note 11 On Avenue of the Americas (Sixth Avenue), between Bleeker and 55th Street, only the east side of the street is in the eruv (on the sidewalk between the lamppost and the building). Note 12 On Bleeker, between Avenue of the Americas (Sixth Avenue) and Mercer, only the north side of the street is in the eruv. Note 12A On Houston, between Mercer and Second Avenue, only the north side of the street is in the eruv. Note 12B On Mercer, between Bleeker and Houston, only the east side of the street is in the eruv. Note 13 On Allen Street, between 1st Street and 2nd Street, only the west side of the street is in the eruv. Note 14 On Avenue A, between 2nd Street and 8th Street, only the west side of the street is in the eruv. Note 15 One can only access Tompkins Square Park from the north or west. The eruv zigzags up Avenue A until the western gate (intersection of St. Marks and Avenue A), at which point the eruv consists of the fence of the park. Coming from the South, the earliest one could cross Avenue A to access the park is St. Marks. Note 16 On Loisaida Avenue (Avenue C), between 11th Street and 13th Street, only the west side of the street is in the eruv. Note 17 All of Stuyvesant Town is in the eruv. Note 18 On 38th Street, between the First and Second Avenues, only the south side of the street is in the eruv. Note 19 On Second Avenue, between 38th Street and 49th Street, only the west side of the street is in the eruv. Harlem extension: Since boundries on 126 Street between Amsterdam and Park Avenues varies, staying on the south side of the street is recommended.
